findings.highlight: Every time I move, I feel my organs shifting around as if with minds of their own.
findings.evidenceJa: その度に傷口から、何か生きていくのに必要なものがごっそりとこぼれ落ちていく。
findings.governingReading: Each exertion makes substantial amounts of something necessary for life spill from the wound; the material remains unnamed.
findings.explanation: Vital material spilling out of the wound becomes organs shifting inside him. This changes both the bodily event and the source's deliberately indistinct description.

findings.highlight: They're really only doing it for their own happiness, while the person they're meant to be helping may not be half so pleased.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなものは独りよがりの幸せで、相手からしてみれば不安定な喜びでしかない。
findings.governingReading: The self-indulgent arrangement gives the other person only an unstable/precarious joy.
findings.explanation: Unstable happiness for the recipient becomes less happiness.

findings.highlight: In spite of that ferocious, murderous rage...
findings.evidenceJa: 目に見える物、その全てを殺さねば気が済まぬという殺気を放ったまま、
findings.governingReading: His murderous aura suggests he would be satisfied only by killing everything in sight, yet he silently leaves.
findings.explanation: The image of killing everything in sight becomes general murderous rage. His silent departure and its unexplained motive remain.

findings.highlight: Looking at it, I feel a surge of disgust rather than fascination.
findings.evidenceJa: その様は、不思議を通り越して不気味だった。
findings.governingReading: The restoration’s appearance goes beyond puzzling strangeness into the eerie/uncanny.
findings.explanation: Strangeness passing into uncanniness becomes disgust instead of fascination.
